title: System-A: Route-Dependent Simulation of Nine Anti-Aging Interventions on Cellular Aging Pathways

contributions.purpose: 模拟给药途径依赖的抗衰干预效应
contributions.mechanism: System-A 管线:因果通路图 + 途径特异 PK/PD 先验(e(r)=σ(k̂_abs(r)·AUC(r)))+ N=120 蒙特卡洛不确定性
contributions.evaluation: 9 种干预 × 6 种途径(PO/IV/SC/TD/IN/SL)的途径-干预矩阵;正文未给任何数值结果
contributions.domain: 计算生物学/抗衰老药理模拟
contributions.source_quote: System-A, an AI-authored simulation framework that estimates delivery-route-dependent effects of nine anti-aging interventions across six routes.

contributions.purpose: 声称呈现途径条件下的变异
contributions.mechanism: 脚本从公开 GEO 数据生成合成 composite 分数 + 敏感性/消融

notes: 数据红旗 + checklist 自曝占位图历史:AI 主笔(问题设定/管线/代码/写作首稿均 AI),checklist 两处自述 'Early placeholder figures were replaced with plots generated directly by our scripts'——暴露先前用过 mock-up 占位图。图注标 '(real data)' 但 Results 称数值系 'generated by our scripts';N=120 MC。全文无任何数值结果(composite/hallmark 分数从未给出),仅 2 页核心极单薄、纯模拟(自认 'Simulation-only; priors may be misspecified')。decision=desk-reject。
